title: Recursive parity assignment identity
statement: Let $n,r,t,q$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$, and let $g\in\text{Fin}(r^q)$. At each child position of $g$, take the product of the signs in the parity tree assignment at depth $t$; the resulting parity block assignment equals the parity tree assignment at depth $t+1$ and position $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
